def check_if_last_char_is_a_letter(txt):
    txt = txt.strip()  # Trim the input string to remove any trailing spaces
    words = txt.split()  # Split the input string into words using space as delimiter

    if len(words) == 0:  # Check if the input string is empty
        return False

    last_word = words[-1]
    if not last_word.isalpha():  # Check if the last word contains only alphabetical characters
        return False

    last_char = txt[-1]
    if last_char.isalpha() and last_char not in last_word:  # Check if the last character of the input string is an alphabetical character and not part of a word
        return True

    return False

def check_if_last_char_is_a_letter(txt):
    if not txt:
        return False
    
    txt = txt.rstrip()  # Remove trailing spaces
    
    if not txt:
        return False
    
    last_char = txt[-1]
    
    if last_char.isalpha() and (len(txt) == 1 or txt[-2] == ' '):
        return True
    else:
        return False
